en:
That's the truth of this case, of the
killing game itself. Well, Tsumugi?
W-Well...what?

Y-Yes! What a scorching hot twist! My hand
holding the detonator is tensing up...
D-Don't get tense! C-C-Calm down!
Daddy! Please, stop this!

Go back to how you used to be, when you
loved us oh-so much!

How I used to be...was more suited to
a different story than this one.
...Huh?

Basically, your story doesn't matter!
I gotta watch this exciting development!

Well, Tsumugi? Are there any flaws
in Shuichi's logic?
If so, then...please tell us.

F-Flaws? There's a bunch of flaws...all
over it.
Then explain.
Y-You can do it! You can do it, Tsumugi!
E-Even if you cheer me on...

It's not like that! I didn't do it!
It's plain to see!

Fight back, Tsumugi! C'mon!
You can do it, you can do it!
Daddy, you're tensing up again!

I still wanna live so please don't push
the button!

Tsumugi, please just say something!
If you don't defend yoursel—
It's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Junko Enoshima<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
...What?
Cuz...it's always been her.

In the Hope's Peak killing game and
in the Jabberwock Island killing game...

Junko Enoshima didn't participate. 
She controlled the game from outside.

Even if it's boring or repetitive,
she's always the mastermind, isn't she!?

Then it's like that this time, too! 
It's gotta be Junko again!

Junko Enoshima is dead.
She's not part of this killing game.

Y-You're wrong...
She hasn't been eliminated... She's...

It's all Junko's doing!
This killing game is her doing, too!

Yeah! That's gotta be it!
Cuz Junko Enoshima is...
Junko Enoshima is?
Cuz Junko Enoshima is...
Junko Enoshima is!?

Daddy, please don't get so excited!
You'll press the button by accident!

Look at our cute faces! Can you really
bear to be without us!?
Junko Enoshima is...
Junko Enoshima is what!?
...Okay, time for a commercial break!
No it isn't!

See, we're a good comedy group, too!
So please don't—
Cuz...Junko Enoshima is...
Junko...Enoshima is...
Right the fuck here!

Puhuhu... 
Sorry to keep you waiting.

Even if nobody was waiting, 
even if it makes you go, "What, again?"...

The diva of despair takes the stage 
once more! <CLT=cltSTRONG>Junko Enoshima the 53rd<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Bwah-hahahaha! There you have it! Once
again, the mastermind is Junko Enoshima!
Bwah-hahahahahaha!
Junko Enoshima...the 53rd?

Tsumugi...wh-what's the matter?
Aren't you...Tsumugi Shirogane?
Our friend who survived with us?

Hahaha, sorry about that. You can go 
ahead and forget about Tsumugi Shirogane.

Cuz I'm just a character!
Y'know, a <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Sorry to all her fans out there.
If any of you even exist, that is.
A-A lie...?

Tsumugi Shirogane was nothing more
than a cover for me, the mastermind.

Puhuhu... Calling her your friend...
Oh, it's laughable, really.

Really, I'm gonna laugh!
Ahahahahahahahaha!

A-Are you serious!? You're the mastermind
behind this?

But, why?
That face and that voice! It's just like...
Junko Enoshima!

I know, right!?
Oh, does it make you fall into despair!?
Ahahaha! Well, does it!?

No, that's not possible...
Junko Enoshima is dead!
But...why did you call yourself "the 53rd"?

As history repeats itself, so does Junko
Enoshima...
Nyeh...?

As you can see, I am a perfect
reproduction of Junko Enoshima.

So...you're just a freak pretending to 
be Junko Enoshima, huh!?
No, a <CLT=cltSTRONG>perfect reproduction<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Perfect reproductions are exactly
the same as the original.

Her logic is impossible to follow, much like
the real Junko Enoshima's...

Whatever it is... You're the actual 
mastermind of this killing game, right?

So if we kill you, then that'll be the end,
correct?

Oh, don't say mean things like that... 
Besides, killing me never ends the game.
It never ends the game? What do you mean?

She's bluffing.
Let's just kill her and get it over with.

Wait! If force is necessary, it should wait
until after we see what she—

No need, Keebo.
Because this class trial is *over*.

What? It's already over?
But I just showed up!

You killed Kaede, and Monokuma covered it up
with a false narrative!

The class trials are rigged, and this
whole game is illegitimate!

Oh that, right. Yeah, I definitely
messed that up. Sorry about that.
So...
So? Is that all you have to say?

The viewers won't accept that kind of 
apology! You gotta stop the killing game!
Eh? The viewers?

Umm... It seems like you're on the
wrong track, so let me explain...

Okay! So first, I'll start with the event
that inspired me to plan this killing game.

That was...about the time the meteorite
impacts started intensifying...

Did she just start some big
story on her own...?

I knew of Hope's Peak Academy's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer
Project<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and my inner Junko told me...

Crushing the Gofer Project, humanity's
last hope, would be the perfect despair.

That's when I took over the
killing game I devised...

I forced those selected as humanity's
last hope to play my killing game.

And then I took the name "Tsumugi
Shirogane" and sneaked in among them.

Did...Kokichi know about this?
Wasn't he a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
He was your comrade, right?

Huh...? Comrade? Junko Enoshima
doesn't have comrades.

It's like, you don't need a remote after
you've thrown out the TV, right?

The Remnants of Despair are just a
bunch of despair fanboys and fangirls.
But I...am despair itself...

I am a god of despair!
Kokichi was just one of my believers!

A god wouldn't be comrades with
one of their believers, right?

Then Kokichi didn't know your true
identity either...

Puhuhu... What a hopeless
existence he led...

To the end, he had no idea the object
of his worship was right under his nose.

I-I don't care about your story!
Tell us about the people watching!

Who's this killing game being shown to!?
Where are the survivors of humanity!?
There's nobody watching.
Huh?

We were the last 16 people alive, y'know?
Who could be watching? Humanity is gone.

No, you're lying... If this isn't being shown
to anyone, why care so much about rules?

You're the one who keeps talking about
making the game interesting! For whom?

That was just a part of my perfect
reproduction.
Your what?

I just perfectly reproduced my own 
killing game is all. Just like the old Junko!

The original was meant to be shown,
so that's how I made mine!

You just wanted to recreate the past
killing game... That's it?
Yup, that's it.

There are no survivors of humanity.
Things are just as you recalled...

That is the truth of the 
Ultimate Academy killing game!
No, that's wrong!
Oh dear! I am so surprised!

Maybe we all remember that there's
no one left out there...
But how do we know our memories are real?

Huh? What do you mean by that?
You think your memories are wrong?

There's something that's been bothering
me about our memories...
Here, look at this book.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>The Complete History of Hope's Peak Academy<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

This book contains years of research
about Hope's Peak Academy.

Nothing would indicate this book is a prop.
I believe the information here is accurate.

But there's a lot written in here that
<CLT=cltSTRONG>differs<CLT=cltNORMAL> from our memories.
...What is different?

To know that for certain, I'll need everyone's
help.

I want you all to tell me everything that
you remember about Hope's Peak Academy.

We just need to talk about what we
remember from Hope's Peak? Okay...

Um... So it started with The Biggest, Most
Awful, Most Tragic Event in Human History.

That event originated at Hope's Peak Academy,
inspiring wars and terrorism around the world.

It would not be hyperbole to say that event
brought <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltNORMAL> to all mankind.

And it was all caused...by a single
high school girl.
Yeah! It was me!

Junko Enoshima enrolled in Hope's Peak 
Academy as the Ultimate Fashionista...

But my real identity was
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

In order to cover the world in
despair, I put my plans—
Wait a minute, something doesn't add up here.

Huh? I detect no discrepancy in my memory
banks...

Yes, everything we just said is
just like we remember it...

But it <CLT=cltSTRONG>doesn't match<CLT=cltNORMAL> what's written
in the history of Hope's Peak Academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'll determine exactly why later...
For now, I need to identify the discrepancy.
So you gotta play "Spot the Difference"!

Point out what everyone is mistaken about
in their memories of Hope's Peak Academy.
Alright! Time to play some Danganronpa trivia!
